notes.title: HSS v0.1.9.12 Early Access update
notes.notes:
[b]HSS 0.1.9.12 release notes:[/b]

This will be the last HSS update. It's been a crazy ride and we appreciate your support throughout this project.

[u]Features:[/u]
- Notification when applying video settings
- Added Puck Trail in progression (levels 19/57/85)
- Added Goal Effects in progression (levels 35/69)
- Regions are now sorted by ping
- Loading Tips are now localized
- Puck/Player camera focus Toggle UI feedback
- Goal post collision are now cylinders instead of octagon, allowing for more precise bounces

[u]Fixes: [/u]
- Controller can now change tabs in profile menu
- In the Character select menu, can now properly select character with left input
- Boost bottle Tooltips now properly visible for all away team players
- Puck Owner indicator is now visible over center ice HSS logo
- Shots stats are added only if they were aimed at the goal

notes.title: HSS v0.1.1.6 Early Access update
notes.notes:
HSS 0.1.1.6 release notes:

[u]Features:[/u]
- Added Discord button in main menu
- Profile menu now accessible banner via controller input
- Overlay description over drinks consumables in Character select menu
- Added faceoff input overlay
- Added visual effect when the puck hits the ice during faceoff
- New option: camera orientation (forward, backward, auto-swap (current) )
- Added a new slapshot clap sound (SCHLAAACK!)
- Additional cross-check damage when hit against a rink board
- Cross-check power bound to player velocity
- Tweaked puck drop mechanic on hit, player can influence the puck drop direction when hit (influenced by Handling skill).
- Changes to puck physics material to be less bouncy
- Change to the ice physics material to be more slippery
- Goaltenders do slides more often
- Removed knockout victory

Fixes: 
- Some connection/lobby issue edge cases
- Several hair 3D mesh repair
- Puck behind goaltender causing accidental goal
- Goaltenders having a little strutt around the ice, leaving their net
- Stats and score not displayed correctly when players disconnect
- Goalers too vulnerable to handling
- Local matches with multiple controllers
